{{recipe}} 

This dish has a lot of Italian flavors, like bay, thyme, rosemary, garlic, and Chianti wine.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] uncooked white [[Cookbook:Rice and Lentils (Mejadra)|rice]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Tsp|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 2 ½ cups low-sodium [[Cookbook:Chicken Broth|chicken broth]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Red Wine|red wine]], preferably Chianti
* 3 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaves]]
* 7 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], smashed
* 10 sprigs fresh [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 5–6 sprigs fresh [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]

== Procedure ==
#Melt butter in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium high heat. Add rice and onion and cook until rice is golden.
#Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients. Once rice has toasted, remove from pot and add mixture. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and add rice. Cook, stirring occasionally, 30 minutes or until rice is desired tenderness.
#Serve warm with a steak, a glass of red wine, and maybe a vegetable sauté.
